description: Smart Meter Insights domain model (Epic AB#4059): end customers of an energy consulting firm, CSV import sessions for 15-minute smart-meter readings, revocable share links for the public read-only dashboard, device detection results and consultant-editable saving recommendations (AB#5245). 1.2.0 adds the ShareLink section flag ShowGridFees2027 for the capacity-based grid-fee analysis (AB#5246). Time-series values reuse Basic.Energy/EnergyMeasurement (one anchor per metering point and OBIS code, slots in the stream-data archive).
